name: 紙片燈塔
description: 紙片立體模型的海邊燈塔，12 fps 停格：戴草帽的企鵝在岩台上釣魚，Claude 工作時釣起比自己大的魚；每個對話是水平線上一艘紙帆船，海鷗吊在線上晃。
description_en: A papercraft lighthouse by the sea at 12 fps stop-motion: a penguin in a straw hat fishes from the rocks and lands fish bigger than itself while Claude works; each session is a paper sailboat on the horizon, gulls dangling on strings.
